input.subject: Monkey D. Luffy
input.intent: Design a long-range melee unit whose elastic attacks reach distant enemies. Organize its three upgrade paths around Conqueror's Haki, Observation Haki and Armament Haki. Represent its Gear forms as special forms that unlock characteristic attacks where the definition supports them. Distinguish the base state, Gears Second through Fifth and Gear Fourth variants; explain unsupported runtime behavior instead of claiming it is implemented.

unit.name: Monkey D. Luffy
unit.summary: Monkey D. Luffy is a long-range melee damage, control and burst unit from the supplied One Piece manga continuity. His base Gum-Gum Pistol stretches and slingshots an elastic punch to distant enemies. Conqueror's Haki provides timed incapacitation and bounded multi-target pressure, Observation Haki provides threat reading, range and attack cadence, and Armament Haki provides reinforced damage plus a projected Haki strike. Gear Second and Gear Third are represented as attack upgrades. Gear Fourth and Gear Fifth are externally selected encounter forms that add characteristic attacks; runtime switching, awakening triggers, simultaneous Gear combinations, reversion, named Gear Fourth variants, environmental rubberization and source-specific resistances are not implemented by this specification.

actions.name: Gum-Gum Pistol
actions.summary: Luffy stretches and slingshots one elastic punch into acquired enemies at long range.

actions.name: Future Sight Scan
actions.summary: Luffy reads the battlefield and repeatedly reveals the strongest eligible threat without simulating literal future prediction.

actions.name: Emission Punch
actions.summary: Luffy projects a finite line-strike of Armament Haki toward a distant enemy.

actions.name: Gear Fourth: Compressed Blow
actions.summary: A fixed Gear Fourth encounter attack compresses and releases an enlarged elastic strike for heavy direct damage.

actions.name: Gear Fifth: Awakened Strike
actions.summary: A fixed Gear Fifth encounter attack delivers an awakened elastic line-strike against up to two enemies.

forms.name: Gear Fourth
forms.summary: An externally selected encounter form that enables a fixed compressed elastic attack. It does not implement runtime transformation, body-state transfer, variant switching or automatic reversion.

forms.name: Gear Fifth
forms.summary: An externally selected encounter form that enables a fixed awakened elastic line-strike. It does not implement a fatal-damage awakening trigger, unrestricted imagination, environmental rubberization, runtime transformation or automatic reversion.

paths.name: Conqueror's Haki
paths.summary: Control and burst progression built around incapacitating pressure, limited collateral reach and the externally selected Gear Fifth form.

paths.name: Observation Haki
paths.summary: Sustained damage progression built around threat reading, expanded elastic reach and Gear Second-inspired cadence.

paths.name: Armament Haki
paths.summary: Damage and penetration adaptation built around reinforced blows, a projected Haki strike, internal-impact damage and Gear Fourth.

nodes.name: Conqueror's Pressure
nodes.summary: Gum-Gum Pistol applies Unconscious for 0.8 seconds, representing Conqueror's Haki pressure against weak-willed targets.

nodes.name: Overwhelming Presence
nodes.summary: Extends Gum-Gum Pistol's Unconscious duration from 0.8 to 1.2 seconds.

nodes.name: Coated Impact
nodes.summary: Conqueror's Haki coating lets each Gum-Gum Pistol emission apply its strike to up to two selected targets.

nodes.name: Dominating Wave
nodes.summary: Raises the coated Gum-Gum Pistol cap to three targets, creating bounded crowd pressure without an unlimited chain.

nodes.name: Gear Fifth
nodes.summary: Grants the externally selectable Gear Fifth form and its fixed awakened elastic line-strike; it does not trigger or revert at runtime.

nodes.name: Sharpened Sight
nodes.summary: Increases Gum-Gum Pistol range from 34 to 42 world units.

nodes.name: Future Sight
nodes.summary: Enables the Future Sight Scan, which repeatedly reveals the strongest eligible threat as a deterministic gameplay approximation rather than literal future simulation.

nodes.name: Gear Second
nodes.summary: Lowers Gum-Gum Pistol cooldown to 0.85 seconds, representing Gear Second's accelerated attack cadence without runtime transformation or strain simulation.

nodes.name: Expanded Awareness
nodes.summary: Increases Gum-Gum Pistol range from 42 to 50 world units, improving distant target access.

nodes.name: Perfected Gear Second
nodes.summary: Lowers Gum-Gum Pistol cooldown to 0.6 seconds for the path's sustained-damage capstone.

nodes.name: Reinforced Fist
nodes.summary: Adds one hit point of Armament Haki reinforcement to each Gum-Gum Pistol strike.

nodes.name: Emission
nodes.summary: Enables a separate projected line-strike of Armament Haki with a 30-world-unit range.

nodes.name: Internal Impact
nodes.summary: Adds a second direct-damage packet to Emission Punch, adapting Internal Destruction without claiming literal penetration-from-within semantics.

nodes.name: Gear Third
nodes.summary: Adds two further hit points to Gum-Gum Pistol, representing Gear Third's enlarged high-damage strike without runtime inflation or post-use shrinking.

nodes.name: Gear Fourth
nodes.summary: Grants the externally selectable Gear Fourth form and its fixed compressed-blow attack; named variants and runtime body transformation are not implemented.

visuals.description: Monkey D. Luffy in his base state wearing his recognizable straw hat and pirate attire, with visibly elastic attack poses.
A stretched arm and slingshot punch effect that clearly communicates long-range melee reach.
Distinct dark Armament Haki coating, subtle Observation Haki awareness cues and a broad Conqueror's Haki pressure accent.
A bounded Gear Fourth encounter appearance with enlarged muscular silhouette and compressed elastic strike presentation.
A bounded Gear Fifth encounter appearance with white hair and clothing, used only when the external form is selected.

animations.description: Luffy pulls back and launches one elastic arm toward the acquired target before snapping it back.
A brief shockwave radiates from Luffy when Conqueror's Haki pressure is applied.
A focused observation cue tracks the strongest eligible threat as it is revealed.
A projected Armament Haki line travels from Luffy toward the distant target.
Gear Fourth uses a compressed release motion; Gear Fifth uses an exaggerated awakened elastic line-strike motion. No live transformation animation is required.

audio.description: A distinct elastic snap and heavy impact sound for Gum-Gum Pistol.
Separate low shockwave accents for Conqueror's Haki and Armament Haki applications.
Distinct encounter-form attack cues for Gear Fourth and Gear Fifth without implying runtime awakening or transformation.

findings.evidence: The Conqueror's Haki node describes the status as affecting weak-willed targets, but the actual effect has no eligibility condition and the base targeting includeTags array is unrestricted. The mechanic therefore applies the status to every otherwise eligible acquired target unless external context supplies resistance.
findings.change: Make the node description explicitly identify weak-will eligibility as an unencoded source limitation supplied by game context, rather than implying that the unit mechanically filters weak-willed targets.

findings.evidence: The supplied diagnostic measured relative utility gains of 0.006664 for Observation tier 1 and 0.004158 for Observation tier 4 across all six scenarios. The range increases are executable but rarely change engagement in the supplied measurements.
findings.change: Increase Observation tier 1 range from 34 to 50 world units and tier 4 range from 50 to 64 world units, updating both summaries so the path has a more consequential long-range breakpoint while remaining within the 8–80 range band.

uncertainties: The supplied diagnostic profile is explicitly uncalibrated, so the larger Observation range breakpoints are a bounded repair rather than proof of improved balance or universal scenario performance.
The consuming game must provide any weak-will eligibility, immunity or resistance context for Conqueror's Haki; this patch does not invent a target-tagging rule.

limits: Source fidelity review remains model judgment. Diagnostics are uncalibrated mechanical evidence.
A rejected or failed review preserves the draft; structural success does not mean the review succeeded.
Only complete valid transactions are committed. Large redesigns and missing top-level structures may remain unrepaired.
Feasibility and source attribution remain model judgments. A supported claim in the plan is not an independent verification of the final implementation.

plan.identity: Public design specification and feasibility report: Monkey D. Luffy is a 600-credit damage/control/burst unit from the supplied One Piece manga continuity. Base state uses a 34-world-unit, 1.1-second Gum-Gum Pistol direct strike: a long-range elastic melee attack. The draft plans no native active abilities, no resources and no damage-over-time; its three prominent declarations are one control mechanic plus two forms,

requests.requirement: Design the unit as Monkey D. Luffy from the supplied One Piece manga continuity.
requests.treatment: Uses Luffy's rubber body, elastic attacks and three Haki paths as the source-specific identity.
requests.limitation: Only the supplied manga-continuity record is used; later or adaptation-specific material is excluded.

requests.requirement: Make the unit a long-range melee attacker whose elastic attacks reach distant enemies.
requests.treatment: The base Gum-Gum Pistol is modeled as a 34-world-unit direct strike, preserving the ranged slingshot punch while allowing melee identity at long range.
requests.limitation: The 34-unit range and 1.1-second cadence are neutral game-design values, not sourced measurements.

requests.requirement: Organize three upgrade paths around Conqueror's Haki, Observation Haki and Armament Haki.
requests.treatment: The three independent paths are named Conqueror's Haki, Observation Haki and Armament Haki, with distinct mutable-property ownership.
requests.limitation: The paths model selected gameplay functions rather than every Haki application.

requests.requirement: Represent Gear forms as special forms where the definition supports them.
requests.treatment: Gear Fourth and Gear Fifth are explicit encounter forms granted at path tier 5; Gear Second and Gear Third are represented as path-owned attack upgrades instead of separate forms.
requests.limitation: Forms are externally selected encounter configurations. They do not activate, switch, combine or revert at runtime.

requests.requirement: Distinguish the base state, Gear Second, Gear Third, Gear Fourth and Gear Fifth.
requests.treatment: Base state is the unupgraded Gum-Gum Pistol; Gear Second is an Observation-owned cadence upgrade; Gear Third is an Armament-owned high-damage upgrade; Gear Fourth and Gear Fifth are separate external forms.
requests.limitation: Live transformation, state transfer, simultaneous Gear Second/Gear Third use and runtime reversion are not implemented.

requests.treatment: A single generic Gear Fourth form is provided, using the sourced compressed-blow distinction without inventing named variants.
requests.limitation: The supplied evidence does not provide a complete Gear Fourth variant catalog, and the form budget does not support separate variant declarations.

requests.requirement: Have forms unlock characteristic attacks where the definition supports them.
requests.treatment: Gear Fourth unlocks a fixed compressed elastic strike and Gear Fifth unlocks a fixed awakened elastic strike; Emission, Gear Second and Gear Third are adapted directly into the base attack through upgrades.
requests.limitation: The source does not supply a complete named-attack catalog, and unrestricted imagination or environmental rubberization is not implemented.

requests.requirement: Explain unsupported runtime behavior rather than claiming it is implemented.
requests.treatment: The specification explicitly labels runtime Gear switching, awakening triggers, reversion, variant switching and simultaneous Gear combinations as unsupported or adapted.
requests.limitation: The consuming engine must still enforce external form selection and encounter persistence.

baseAttack.description: Gum-Gum Pistol: Luffy stretches and slingshots an elastic punch into one acquired enemy for direct damage. It is a long-range melee-style attack; Armament upgrades can convert its delivery into a piercing line strike.

paths.name: Conqueror's Haki
ownedProperties: Gear Fifth form grant and fixed form-attack package
progression: Tier 1: Unlocks Conqueror's Haki pressure, applying a declared Unconscious status for 0.8 seconds, maximum one stack, refreshing on reapplication.
Tier 2: Extends the Unconscious status duration to 1.2 seconds.
Tier 3: Adapts Conqueror's coating into a base-attack maximum target cap of 2 when the attack has line delivery.
Tier 4: Raises that base-attack cap to 3.
Tier 5: Grants the locked Gear Fifth form for external encounter selection, with its fixed awakened strike.

paths.name: Observation Haki
progression: Tier 1: Raises base-attack range from 34 to 42 world units.
Tier 2: Adapts Observation Haki and Future Sight into a priority for the most advanced eligible enemy.
Tier 3: Adapts Gear Second into a 0.85-second base-attack cooldown, without runtime transformation.
Tier 4: Raises base-attack range from 42 to 50 world units.
Tier 5: Improves base-attack cooldown to 0.6 seconds.

paths.name: Armament Haki
ownedProperties: Gear Fourth form grant and fixed form-attack package
progression: Tier 1: Raises base-attack direct damage by 1 through Haki reinforcement.
Tier 2: Changes the base attack from direct-strike to line-strike, adapting Emission into a projected elastic-Haki blow.
Tier 3: Adds a second direct-damage packet to each acquired target hit, adapting Internal Destruction without claiming literal penetration.
Tier 4: Adapts Gear Third into a further +2 base-attack damage increase, with no post-use shrinking.
Tier 5: Grants the locked Gear Fourth form for external encounter selection, with its fixed compressed strike.

mechanics.name: Conqueror's Haki pressure
mechanics.implementation: The declared Unconscious status is applied by the base attack after Conqueror tier 1. It lasts 0.8 seconds initially, stacks once, refreshes on reapplication and expires normally. Enemy immunity or resistance is supplied by game context; no boss immunity is invented.

mechanics.name: Observation Haki and Future Sight
mechanics.implementation: Observation tier 2 changes targeting priority to the most advanced eligible enemy. Future Sight is therefore an executable targeting approximation, not literal several-second prediction or combat simulation.

mechanics.name: Gear Second attack adaptation
mechanics.implementation: Observation tier 3 lowers the base attack cooldown to 0.85 seconds, representing accelerated circulation and speed without declaring a runtime form.

mechanics.name: Gear Third attack adaptation
mechanics.implementation: Armament tier 4 adds high direct damage to the base attack, representing enlarged high-damage strikes without implementing body inflation, runtime transformation or shrinking.

mechanics.name: Emission adaptation
mechanics.implementation: Armament tier 2 changes the base delivery to line-strike, representing a finite projected Haki blow while retaining explicit range and target caps.

mechanics.name: Internal Destruction adaptation
mechanics.implementation: Armament tier 3 adds a second direct-damage packet to every eligible hit. Literal penetration and destruction from within are not asserted.

mechanics.name: Gear Fourth form
mechanics.implementation: A locked form granted by Armament tier 5 and selected externally for the encounter. It enables a fixed 38-world-unit direct-strike compressed elastic attack with a 1.4-second interval. Persistence is the encounter, activation is external and reversion is none.

mechanics.name: Gear Fifth form
mechanics.implementation: A locked form granted by Conqueror tier 5 and selected externally for the encounter. It enables a fixed 46-world-unit line-strike awakened elastic attack with a 1.0-second interval and a maximum of 2 targets. It is not triggered by fatal damage and does not provide imagination-driven or environmental transformations.

omissions.sourceTrait: Gear Second, Gear Third, Gear Fourth and Gear Fifth as runtime transformations with live switching or reversion.
omissions.reason: The contract supports only externally selected encounter forms with no runtime transformation, state transfer or reversion. Gear Second and Gear Third are honest attack upgrades; Gear Fourth and Gear Fifth are external forms.

omissions.sourceTrait: Simultaneous Gear Second and Gear Third use.
omissions.reason: The form system does not support arbitrary live combinations, and the two Gears are represented as independent path upgrades rather than combinable runtime states.

omissions.sourceTrait: Gear Second strain, rapid energy consumption and possible lifespan shortening.
omissions.reason: No source-defined resource, self-damage or lifespan system is requested, and exact costs and recovery values are not supplied.
Runtime body-state reversion is unsupported; the upgrade uses the supplied post-timeskip controlled version as its neutral implementation.

omissions.sourceTrait: Full Gear Fourth body inflation, leg exception and air-propelled mobility.
omissions.reason: The supported subset is the fixed compressed high-damage attack. Body transformation and movement behavior are not represented as runtime mechanics.

omissions.sourceTrait: Named or separately selectable Gear Fourth variants.
omissions.reason: The supplied evidence does not provide a complete variant catalog, so no variants are invented; only one generic Gear Fourth form is declared.

omissions.sourceTrait: Gear Fifth awakening trigger, white visual transformation, unrestricted imagination and rubberization of the environment or living beings.
omissions.reason: The form is externally selected and grants only a fixed awakened attack. Triggered awakening, visual-state requirements, unrestricted imagination and environmental or living-target transformation are outside the executable subset.

omissions.sourceTrait: Armament Haki defensive reinforcement, Devil Fruit defense negation and contact with otherwise protected targets.
omissions.reason: Defense modifiers, defense-negation semantics and protected-target context are not declared in this unit spec.
The implementation uses deterministic target priority rather than future simulation; no exact reliability or prediction window is supplied.
The effect model supports direct damage but has no penetration-from-within parameter, so the mechanic is adapted to a second damage packet.

omissions.sourceTrait: Rubber electric immunity, blunt-force resistance, sharp-object weakness, water or Sea-Prism Stone weakness and poison immunity.
omissions.reason: These require damage-type, resistance, environmental or status-context systems not included in the requested unit specification; no unsupported stat modifier is invented.

uncertainties: The supplied record does not fully catalog named attacks or Gear Fourth variants.
The 600-credit cost, 34-to-50 base range, attack intervals, status durations and damage values are neutral design values rather than source facts.
Weak-willed eligibility and status resistance must come from supplied game context; this specification does not invent immunity rules.
External form unlock timing is defined here by the owning tier-5 grant, while any broader encounter-unlock system belongs to the consuming game.

The draft is structurally feasible under classic-three-path 0.1: two forms plus one control declaration stay within the three prominent-mechanic limit, no native active abilities are declared, all form and attack ranges remain within 8-80 world units, and all listed intervals remain within 0.15-30 seconds. This does not establish combat balance.

effectiveLimits.prominentMechanicCounting: Every declared ability plus every declared form plus one if control is used plus one if damage-over-time is used. Locked declarations still count. Resources do not directly count, but their associated abilities and forms do.

forms.requirements: empty; grant-form upgrade or explicit external unlock

effectiveLimits.formLimitations: Forms are external encounter selections. They do not switch at runtime, revert, enforce mutually exclusive modes, or make arbitrary combinations safe. A grant-form upgrade unlocks a later external build selection.
effectiveLimits.intervalCadence: For an enabled primary interval action, scheduled period = max(trigger.intervalSeconds, timing.cooldownSeconds). A fixed trigger interval can mask cooldown upgrades. A trigger floor of 0.15 seconds allows cooldown upgrades down to that floor; use a different explicit interval only when intentional. Windup delays resolution separately.
effectiveLimits.delivery: Direct-strike and line-strike can have range up to the same configured maximum as projectiles. Melee does not imply short range. Projectile primary aim count and collateral pierce are separate; do not infer a combined minimum target cap.

uncheckedRules: Character fidelity and prose/mechanic agreement require review.
The consuming game must implement these mechanics.
Runtime reachability, numerical balance and enjoyable progression are not established.
